title: Étale proper direct-image finiteness
statement: Let $X$ and $Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] which are Noetherian (each has a finite affine open cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]) and finite-dimensional (the Krull dimension of each underlying space [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] is bounded above by a nonnegative integer), let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] whose geometric fibres [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] have Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] at most $e\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$, and let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring whose underlying set is finite whose element orders are invertible in every local ring of $Y$. For every constructible sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] $F$ of $\Lambda$-modules on the small étale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], the sheaves $R^qf_{\Et,*}F$ are constructible $\Lambda$-module sheaves on $Y_{\Et}$ for all integers $q\geq0$, and $R^qf_{\Et,*}F=0$ for every $q>2e$.

proof.text: Noetherian X and Y are quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Proper f is separated, quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and locally of finite type; over locally Noetherian Y it is locally of finite presentation. These instances supply precisely the geometric hypotheses of compactification constructibility.

Put F in degree zero as K in the bounded-below derived category. The single-functor homology isomorphism identifies H^0(K) with F; the standard t-structure makes H^q(K) zero for q nonzero. The equivalence between finite-value and finite-stalk module constructibility transports constructibility through these isomorphisms, and zero sheaves are constructible. Choose Compactification.ofIsProper f, whose open immersion is the identity. Extension by zero along the identity is naturally the identity: identify it with identity pullback by upperStarIsoOpenImmersionLowerShriekInv, then use upperStarId. Applying the exact derived functor to this isomorphism removes that factor from the compact-support candidate.

Apply isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_homology_compactSupportCandidate to this K and the identity compactification. Transport its constructible homology along the preceding isomorphism to the total right derived direct image. The rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility isomorphism identifies it with higherDirectImage in every integer degree. This proves the constructibility clause (in fact without needing nonnegativity).

For a point y of Y use exactly x=Y.algClosurePoint y. The proper base change isomorphism isIso_geometricFiber_finite applies to K at x. Exact pullback commutes with homology and with the degree-zero single functor. Their comparison isomorphisms identify x^* higherDirectImage(f,q,F) with higherDirectImage(pullback.snd f x,q,(pullback.fst f x)^* F). No enlargement of the chosen algebraic closure or comparison of local fibre dimensions is needed.

The geometric-fibre projection is proper by base change, hence quasi-compact and locally of finite type over its algebraically closed, therefore separably closed, field. Its source dimension is at most e by the given hypothesis at y. Finite coefficients are additive torsion, by isOfFinAddOrder_of_finite. Apply the existing source-library isZero_higherDirectImage_of_two_mul_lt to the fibre projection, using that same projection as a_X and the identity as a_Y. It makes this fibre higher direct image zero for q>2e, without any constructibility assumption. Transport zero across the preceding isomorphism. Finally isZero_of_forall_isZero_upperStar_algClosurePoint, the existing consequence of geometric-stalk conservativity, makes the original module sheaf zero. This includes empty fibres and empty Y.

lean.statement: theorem proper_directImage_finiteness {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] (hXdim : ∃ d : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) (hYdim : ∃ d : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim Y ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (e : ℕ) (hfib : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim ↥(pullback f (Y.algClosurePoint y)) ≤ (e : WithBot ℕ∞)) (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] (hΛ : ∀ (a : Λ) (y : Y), IsUnit (addOrderOf a : Y.presheaf.stalk y)) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (hF : Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf F) : (∀ q : ℤ, 0 ≤ q → Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf (higherDirectImage Λ f q F)) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, (2 * e : ℤ) < q → IsZero (higherDirectImage Λ f q F))
